thread_text:
Asha: Morning all, quick async standup for gateway/routing/auth/rate limits.
Asha: What I did: landed the routing-policy matcher refactor (PR #4123), ran unit tests and a local canary.
Asha: Blockers: intermittent 429s showing on canary low-priority lane around ~120rps — suspect token-bucket config or lane weighting math.
Sam: On it, can hop into logs when you share. Was there a spike window?
Asha: Mostly between 09:13-09:18 UTC, short bursts. Jon's deploy-bot noted host-2 flapped.
Lee: I pushed a tiny auth cache backport this morning — could cause extra cache misses if host hit a shard boundary.
Lee: Added flag `--log-auth-cache-misses` to staging binary for extra visibility.
Maria: I saw similar behavior in a staging loadtest; lowering `burst_percent` from 30 -> 15 fixed it temporarily.
Asha: Good point, I'll diff canary vs staging rate configs now. If burst is higher on canary that's a strong lead.
Jon: deploy-bot: Canary roll deployed at commit f2c3b9 to 3 hosts. host-2 reported 503 for ~20s during rollout.
Sam: I saw a TLS handshake flake on host-2 earlier, restarted proxy and it cleared. Retries could explain extra load into the bucket.
Asha: Plan: (1) diff configs (2) add bucket_fill_pct metric and quick grafana panel (3) temporarily lower burst_percent on canary (4) observe for 10m, rollback if issues.
Maria: If you lower burst, set a short rollback timer so product leads can revert if we under-serve.
Asha: Will do. @Sam please stand by for logs — I'll paste `kubectl logs -f gw-canary` snippet.
Sam: Ready. Happy to pair 10-15m after lunch.
Lee: For quick revert, use `scripts/rollback-canary.sh --force` I keep that template up to date.
Asha: Tail snippet (sanitized):
Asha: [2026-03-18T09:14:02Z] INFO route=low-prio req_id=xxx rate=120 bucket=67% -> 429
Asha: [2026-03-18T09:14:03Z] INFO auth=cache miss uid=zzz retry=1
Asha: [2026-03-18T09:14:03Z] WARN proxy=host-2 tls=handshake_failed
Asha: Looks like auth misses + tls flake => retries bumping the bucket.
Jon: I can run a small traffic replay (60/90/120rps) against canary to reproduce.
Maria: If Jon reproduces, we can quickly test burst settings. I'll watch SLIs and latency.
Sam: I'll run `rate-debug` with the same headers to emulate retries once you post logs.
Asha: Update: lowered burst_percent from 30 -> 12 on canary, added bucket_fill_pct metric and restarted proxies.
Asha: Early telemetry: 0 429s in last 5m but throughput is down ~5%. Monitoring latency and error budget.
Maria: Good catch. Keep an eye on tail latency — don't want user-visible regressions.
Sam: I'll open a small PR to tag retry-generated requests so we can split SLI by retry vs first attempt.
Asha: Current status: mitigated for now; root cause likely auth cache misses combined with TLS flakiness. Will follow up with a short postmortem if we confirm.
Sam: :ok_hand:
Lee: Thanks everyone, ping if you need a hand.
